kind: A pilot at full size, one seed, 24,000 updates: the lifted loop with power-law cells, beside the lifted loop of the same recipe. It runs only if power_cells_with_data.json's reading is a fix or a constant gain.
why: Power-law cells fire round(k * k / 8) spikes for k thresholds of charge, the spike form of a squared rectifier, with a plain cell's synapses (f876392). On the laptop's test bed they lead the plain cells by 0.0262 after 6,000 updates at equal parameters and pulses (power_cells_screen.json); power_cells_with_data.json reads two server seeds tonight. At full size the looped stack's firing cells send a median of 5 to 9 spikes in most levels and 16 to 17 in the top two (experiments/cell_activity.py on fsp-loop, the first 8,192 validation bytes), so 8 thresholds sits near the median there as on the bed. The next full-length run (full_size_lifted_loop_second) takes a change only through a full-size pilot.

arms.fs-loop6-lift-pw8: sched/bin/full.sh stack fs-loop6-lift-pw8 --lr 6e-4 --stack-loop 2,8,2 --pulse-budget 507000 --pool-lifts-ceiling --granule-power 8, on the code copy of f876392 (v18c); the parameters of fs-loop6-lift

base: fs-loop6-lift (1.300729): the lifted loop at 6e-4 of full_size_loop_variants.json, the same recipe, seed and measure; beside it fs-loop6 (1.31024) and the Transformer of the rate pilot at 6e-4 (1.28370).
runs: 24,000 updates of 8 windows of 512 bytes, peak rate 6e-4, warmup 1,000, cosine over the run, seed 20001; queued by sched/bin/pw-decide.sh on GPU 0 at priority 34 as soon as power_cells_with_data.json reads a fix or a constant gain, and not run otherwise.
measure: full.sh's score, as for fs-loop6-lift: averaged weights on the first 2,000,000 validation bytes as 16 unbroken streams after 8,192 lead bytes, bits of every piece kept; paired with fs-loop6-lift (experiments/compare_stream_scores.py) and split by context (experiments/gap_by_piece.py, near 240, far 8,192); the pulses a byte; the cells' firing (experiments/cell_activity.py).
reading: Power-law cells join the next full-length run if fs-loop6-lift-pw8 is at least 0.005 better than fs-loop6-lift with the paired interval clear of zero. Its pulses a byte are reported beside, and if they are more than a tenth above fs-loop6-lift's every claim states them. Between 0 and 0.005 better: reported, and a second seed decides. Otherwise power-law cells stay on the bed.
seen_before_recording: power_cells_screen.json with pw8-6k-s3 (1.602131); the firing of fsp-loop's cells; fs-loop6-lift's score. No full-size run with power-law cells has trained.

result.pairing: fs-loop6-lift-pw8 against fs-loop6-lift (1.300729): -0.0137 [-0.0145, -0.0129] over 4,160 pieces of 512 bytes (ahead)

firing.measure: experiments/cell_activity.py on the first 8,192 validation bytes as 16 streams after 256 lead bytes, the eleven firing levels of the looped stack from the bottom up (full_size_power_cells_activity.json)

result.beside: the rate pilot's Transformer (dim 512, 11 layers, 34,752,000 parameters; the same 24,000 updates and measure, full_size_rate_pilot.json): 1.28370 at 6e-4, 0.0033 better than fs-loop6-lift-pw8, and 1.27625 at its best rate, 1.2e-3, 0.0108 better; it is scored in windows holding 496 bytes of history, the stack as streams
result.reading: Passes its mark: power-law cells are 0.0137 better than the plain cells of the same lifted loop, with the interval clear of zero, at equal parameters and 0.4% more pulses a byte (515,340 against 513,300), well under the tenth that would have to be stated. They gain on new contexts (0.018 over 76% of the bytes) and far copies (0.019) and lose on seen contexts with another follower (0.037 over 5% of the bytes). The code is sparser: in every level about half as many cells fire at a byte (5 to 25% against 10 to 44%), and the cells that fire have a longer tail (90th percentile 28 to 122 spikes against 15 to 33). The gain at full size is larger than the bed's (0.0128 on two seeds). By power_cells_with_data.json's amendment, power-law cells join fsp-lift2 only if the four-seed reading of the bed is also a fix or a constant gain; seeds 3 and 4 finish about 04:00 UTC.
